title: Webhook Reliability, Retention History & Security Fixes

[Back to Changelog](https://www.getconvoy.io/changelog)


# Webhook Reliability, Retention History & Security Fixes


Monday, September 28th, 2026


Convoy 26.8.0 makes webhook delivery more reliable, helps you understand delivery failures, and shows what retention cleaned up. It also includes security and dashboard fixes.


**What's improved**


- More reliable event routing and retry timing.
- Cleanup history for partitioned event tables.
- Clearer explanations for skipped and failed deliveries.
- Better menus and tooltips on smaller screens.


**Reliability and access fixes**


- Accepting an organisation invitation requires the invited user's signed-in session.
- Event-type changes require project-management permission.
- OAuth2 connection tests block requests to private network addresses.
- Notification address checks recognise more address formats.
- Batch retry previews count candidates consistently with the retry operation.
- Deleted circuit-breaker targets no longer cause repeated notification errors.


After upgrading, review your delivery diagnostics and retention history in Admin.


Designed, built & written by


Smart Mekiliuwa
